profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Zephyr AI
profile.summary: Versatile programmer with 20+ years of professional experience across a broad spectrum of responsibilities, including backend development, tools development, CI/CD, and project leadership roles. Self-driven and a fast learner, dedicated to helping team members grow and excel together.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Python and +9 skills

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
- Modernized and maintained AWS backend services for Directed Scouting, a suite of tools that allow farmers to leverage satellite imagery and analysis to discover and track areas of interest in fields.
- Established logging systems in Datadog to collect metrics, ensure service reliability, and provide immediate alerts on errors.
- Advocated for coding standards and best practices in studio-wide Backend Community of Practice.
- Wrote custom linter tool to ensure OpenAPI documentation on endpoints adhered to internal standards (which I proposed and the Community of Practice ratified and adopted).
positions.insights: Ubuntu, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +20 skills

positions.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Established studio-wide automation processes using Jenkins to build, verify, and publish game and tools projects. Increased automation by 300% while reducing average build downtime by 50+%.
- Built a custom GUI application using wxPython, SQLAlchemy, and Jenkins REST, allowing users to easily monitor and track ongoing build issues across 70 jobs, running simultaneously on 50 build machines and 15 consoles.
- Designed and implemented a custom deployment application for daily delivery of verified game and editor builds to 200+ internal dev team members and outsourcers.
- Operated and maintained assert/crash dump logging system, for automated creation of bug reports in Hansoft project management software.
- Collaborated with Project Directors to provide custom automated solutions (e.g.: mass data processing and verification, memory and performance tracking, source control integrity validation).
- Spearheaded initiatives for improving product stability and reliability, and revitalizing company culture with respect to testing and automation.

positions.title: Senior Core Technology Programmer
positions.description:
- Rewrote low-level memory and object management systems for new Core Technology Engine, forming the basis for all future game projects.
- Architected Timeline Editor for use with the new engine, allowing artists and designers to script complex movement of objects and synchronize triggering of events.

positions.title: Project Technical Director
positions.description:
- Directed a team of ~30 programmers, managing project and individual needs, and ensuring all deadlines and dependencies were met.
- Coordinated with Producer and other Project Directors to plan, schedule, and organize all technical aspects of the game.
- Provided high-level guidance on programming issues, identifying logistical and technical concerns for proposed systems.
